t: How to use Wokwi Arduino Simulator in 2022? What is Wokwi? - Hackster.io
s: January 18, 2023 - Wokwi Arduino simulator supports Arduino UNO, Mega, Nano, and several other boards. It simulated various parts (Wokwi elements) such as LEDs, Shift registers, Buzzers, sensors (ultrasonic, temperature, humidity, etc. ), SSD displays, and keypads. You can learn Arduino programming wherever you are.

t: Hardware Simulation with Wokwi x TinyGo | by Tobenna Kelvin Abanofor | Medium
s: May 8, 2024 - Of course all of this can only happen if at first you have the money to buy components, and after you have waited a while for part deliveries. I believe this barrier to entry has prevented developers from trying out hardware programming. Well… not until wokwi🎉. Wokwi is bridging two gaps I see so far, making cicuit design opensource, and allowing us to develop embedded systems in a simulated environment, saving us the financial burden.
